summary: Initializes struct state from two global DWORD constants plus a fixed flag: calls StructInitWithConditionalNotify first and captures its result, writes dword_5D6D60 cast to float into this+0xC, writes dword_5D6D64 (loaded via a double) cast to float into this+0x10, sets the byte at this+0x14 to 1, and returns the StructInitWithConditionalNotify result. Called by CamMan_Restart to re-initialize state; the globals are proposed as screen width/height only in the skeleton fill (DERIVED).

local_names.widthFloat: float at this+0xC, initialized from dword_5D6D60 (proposed ScreenWidth, DERIVED)
local_names.heightFloat: float at this+0x10, initialized from dword_5D6D64 (proposed ScreenHeight, DERIVED)

operations.description: Calls StructInitWithConditionalNotify and stores its return value as this function's result.
Writes dword_5D6D60 cast to float into this+0xC.
Loads dword_5D6D64 into a double register in preparation for the float store.
Writes dword_5D6D64 (via the double load) cast to float into this+0x10.
Sets the byte at this+0x14 to 1 (active/enabled flag).
Returns the result captured from StructInitWithConditionalNotify.

unresolved: dword_5D6D60 and dword_5D6D64 are proposed as ScreenWidth/ScreenHeight only in the skeleton fill (DERIVED); the packet itself does not evidence their semantic role.
StructInitWithConditionalNotify's behavior and what the this+0x14 flag (set to 1) enables are not evidenced.
